topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It's strange, really, how the world feels so vast and yet, here we are. I stumbled upon the realization that you're not just a series of messages on a screen, but someone who walks the same streets, perhaps even passes by the same trees. I’ve been going over our conversations, remembering the laughter and the late-night musings, wondering if I should have been more careful, more deliberate. It’s not that I regret the talks or the shared stories, but now the invisible feels too close, too real. I find myself wanting to say something, anything, to make the silence between us as comfortable as it was before. Maybe a coffee, if you’re free? It would be nice to see you, finally, just to talk.
